title: Research code and supporting data for: A Multi-Agent Framework for Regional Landslide Susceptibility Mapping and Multi-Hazard Fragility Assessment of Rural Buildings
description:
Research scripts, archived numerical data, 50 eligible-case Abaqus INP decks and portable verification utilities accompanying manuscript 1022. Covers Tianshui landslide susceptibility and conditional runout, nine rural-building archetypes under prescribed landslide/debris-flow/rockfall loads, local fragility bounds, municipal scenario maps, and a separate parametric annual-risk benchmark. Raw third-party DEM/inventory/footprint geometry, proprietary solvers and the full unpublished manuscript are excluded.

Software: MIT. Authored non-spatial numerical data: CC BY 4.0. OSM/Overture-linked database derivatives: ODbL with provider attribution, as detailed in DATA_LICENSES.md. Spatial scenario classes are not surveyed building attributes. The benchmark EAL is not assigned to real mapped buildings.
